name: markets.rivo/rivo
title: Rivo: Polymarket & Kalshi
description: Polymarket & Kalshi whale trades, ranked traders, backtests and Autopilot. From $12/wk or $25/mo.

tools.name: biggest_bets_today
tools.description: The 10 largest bets in the last 24 hours on Kalshi or Polymarket: market, side, price, size, and the trader's record. No sign-in needed. Cached; for the live feed, sign in.

tools.name: top_traders
tools.description: The 10 top prediction market traders by tracked profit, on Kalshi, Polymarket or both, with their win and loss record. Market makers are labelled. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: trader_record
tools.description: One trader's tracked record on Kalshi or Polymarket: wins, losses, profit and their latest trades. Pass `trader` as top_traders and biggest_bets_today return it: the name on Kalshi, the wallet address on Polymarket. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: game_bets

tools.name: market_odds

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description: Large trades on the venues, newest first, reaching back 30 days. Answers "what are whales buying". Each row names the market (with its ref), the side, price, dollars and, where the venue names traders, the trader with their record. Every row older than an hour counts toward the account's 5,000 trades a day; rows from the last hour are free. With exactly one trader: since can reach back 90 days, and include small adds that trader's smaller trades too (newest first only); either counts the trader toward the account's 100 traders a day.

Each different trader opened counts toward the account's 100 traders a day; opening the same one again that day is free.

tools.name: backtest
tools.description: Score copying a signal, or one trader, on markets that already settled: bets, wins, return and a profit curve. Send exactly one of signal, trader or bot (a bot id from list_bots, scored with its own trader or signal, sizing, copy rules, exits and daily limit; fields sent beside it override the bot's). A signal that names no traders reaches back at most 90 days. A trader backtest replays what a paper bot copying them would do, holding each bet to settlement unless mirrorExits is true; copy and dailyCapUsd apply a trader bot's copy rules and daily limit. Its live block is what a real-money bot would have made, at live prices, fees and fill rates; quote live over the paper numbers when judging a trader. slippage scores the live block at a bot's slippage. On Kalshi, live.slippage gives a trader's estimate at 2, 3, 5, 10 and 20 cents (fill rate, profit, return, max drawdown), to compare settings. holdout, sweep and breakdown work on signals only and each costs one more request (a sweep, one per value past the first). Saves nothing and places nothing.

tools.name: place_paper_order
tools.description: Buy or sell one side of a market on paper, at the venue's live price including its fee. No money moves. A buy is sized in usd (maxPrice caps the price paid); a sell in contracts or "all" (minPrice floors it). requestId is any string chosen by the caller; a retry with the same requestId never places the order twice.

tools.name: get_bot_audit
tools.description: One bot's execution log as CSV, oldest first: the same file as Download trades in the app and GET /v2/bots/{id}/audit.csv. A trader or signal bot has one row per trade it decided on: copied, skipped and why, or sent and not filled. Each row has the trader's price, size and time, when the bot decided, its limit, when its order was sent and how long it worked, the order book it went into (best ask, contracts at or under the limit), its fill, fee and how the market settled. source_trade_id is the same on every copy and skip of one trader trade (paper or live, any bot), position is the bet (count distinct positions, not rows), and rivo_received_at_utc with seconds_trader_to_rivo splits a delay into the feed's and the bot's. A market bot has one row per trade. Use it to see why a live copy missed. Defaults to the last 7 days; one call counts as one trade listing.

tools.name: update_bot
tools.description: Change a paper bot's name, sizing, signal, rule, exits, copy rules, daily limit, slippage or alerts; a market bot's buy windows, sale before the close and pause limits (null clears each); or claim a signal bot's history. status pauses or resumes a trader or market bot; a signal bot records every match while it exists, so archive or delete it to stop it. archived true archives a bot (it stops, keeps its record and no longer counts toward the bot limits); false restores it, paused for a trader or market bot. Send archived on its own. A bot that trades real money can only be changed in the app.
